root type: domain threaded
root subtree: cpu pids
testcg type: domain invalid
docker type: threaded
docker subtree: cpu pids

observation.command: R=/sys/fs/cgroup; echo "root type: $(cat $R/cgroup.type)"; echo "root subtree: $(cat $R/cgroup.subtree_control)"; mkdir -p $R/testcg 2>&1; echo "testcg type: $(cat $R/testcg/cgroup.type 2>&1)"; rmdir $R/testcg 2>/dev/null; echo "docker type: $(cat $R/docker/cgroup.type)"; echo "docker subtree: $(cat $R/docker/cgroup.subtree_control)"
